China has a long history of rallying its population around collective goals, from economic development to family planning. Now, Beijing is encouraging people to pursue a personal goal on a national scale: losing weight.

A section of a notice on 'Issuing the Implementation Plan for the "Weight Management Year" Campaign', June 26, 2024. Credit: National Health Commission
